label: demo_seed_policy_ablation
why: IDF-anchor removes lone generic-verb seeds (book→uber) without overfitting one query; relative cutoff further limits expansion to near-top seeds. Fanout-only hurt demo P/R. Rel-cutoff alone left cancel_uber on the long demo query. Sealed proxy c16 nearly unchanged for idf_anchor; rel_cut alone regressed.

sealed_proxy.note: BM25 seeds + memory REQUIRES expand on seed-7 sealed split (n=318). Not a re-seal of hydra MSpaths; product fuse_demo is demo-path only — sealed eval_v3.load_arm still uses full fused fan-in.

headline_eval.note: Sealed B1/H1–H4 numbers unchanged; seed policy is applied only in ToolgraphService.fuse_demo / load_tools, not eval_v3.load_arm.

latency_notes: Cold path still pays one Hydra MSpaths call on 0.1 CPU (~1–3.6s with 3 expand seeds vs ~6.5s with 32). Warm repeats hit an in-process load_tools cache (~0ms). ensure_hydra_synced is a no-op after bootstrap.
